Deferring the 3 Benighat farm adults is the cheapest option, at a total cost of 102. The direct road to Benighat farm is impassable, so reaching it from Naukunda shelter means going through Likhu school (21 + 22 = 43 min each way).

| Option | Driving (min) | Penalties | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Defer everyone | 0 | 6 adults × 20 = 120 | 120 |
| **Rescue the 3 at Likhu, defer the 3 at Benighat** | **21 + 21 = 42** | **3 adults × 20 = 60** | **102** |
| One trip via Benighat (3 from Benighat, 1 from Likhu), defer 2 | 21 + 22 + 22 + 21 = 86 | 2 adults × 20 = 40 | 126 |
| Rescue everyone (the trip above, plus a Likhu round trip for the last 2) | 86 + 42 = 128 | 0 | 128 |

Rescuing fewer people from Likhu doesn't help: the round trip still costs 42 minutes, and each extra deferral adds 20. Picking up a Benighat adult adds 44 minutes of driving but saves only 20 per person, and the car has just one seat left after the 3 Likhu adults.

<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter likhu-school
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 likhu-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer benighat-farm adult 3
</plan>

COST: 102
